title: Supported seated side reach
summary: An invented supported posture record that keeps entry, stay, and exit distinct.

instruction.posture: Sit on firm support with one hand grounded and the other arm reaching overhead without collapsing the lower side.

transitions.cue: Raise the arm before beginning the side reach.
Return the trunk upright before lowering the arm.

modifications.note: Sit higher on a folded blanket or firm chair if the pelvis rolls backward.

variations.note: Keep the reaching hand on the shoulder instead of overhead.

cautions: Avoid the overhead reach if it provokes shoulder pain or tingling.
safety.notes: Educational visualization only and not a claim that the posture is suitable for every person.

source.tradition_basis: Project-authored posture description using general yoga distinctions among entry, posture, exit, modification, and props.
source.rights_basis: provisional: project-authored description; no class sequence, teacher wording, recording, or commercial anatomy was copied
